study type: secondary data analysis of a cohort study
cohort: The study involved 1709 pregnant women living with HIV who delivered their babies in the Eastern Cape province of South Africa between September 2015 and May 2018.
finding: The study found that low birth weight was associated with ART initiated during the second trimester and higher HIV viral loads, while preterm and very preterm birth were associated with higher HIV viral loads and lower CD4 counts among pregnant women living with HIV.
